# dsh-sidebar-browser-use
中文版
Browser-use MCP for DeepSeek Harness. The model drives the built-in right-sidebar browser through ex
actly two stable tools, so the model-facing tool surface never grows and prompt caching stays stable
ctly two stable tools, so the model-facing tool surface never grows and prompt caching stays stable.
## Exposed Tools
Most browser MCPs expose 15-40 tools at once. This one exposes:
- `browser_use_list` - returns the internal tool catalog (names, kinds, parameters, examples). Read-

only, no approval.
- `browser_use_call` - executes one internal tool: `{ tool, args, reason? }`. The
only execution entry and the only approval point.
Internal tools: `browser_tabs`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_text`, `browser_screenshot`, `browser_n
avigate`, `browser_click`, `browser_fill`, `browser_press`, `browser_history`, `browser_open`, and `
browser_eval` (disabled by default).

## Known limitations
- Desktop only. The web profile renders the sidebar browser in an iframe, which has no `executeJavaS

cript`.
- The MCP server is process-wide; it has no per-session isolation.
- Bridge commands are not
routed per window: with several DSH windows open, any renderer may claim a command and run it again

st its own sidebar browser. Single-window use is recommended.
- Cross-origin iframes are not readabl

e from the page script; same-origin iframe subtrees are not traversed either.
- In-page navigation (
link clicks, form submits) does not create history entries in the sidebar webview; `browser_history

back` skips those pages and returns to the most recent `browser_navigate` page.
- A ref is valid onl

y until the next `browser_snapshot`.
- Screenshots are downscaled to 1600x1200; a base64 image over
~2M characters is refused with a hint to use browser_snapshot.
## Troubleshooting
- Host diagnostics: the plugin logs through the standard DSH logger (`browser-use-mcp`); `$DSH_HOME/
browser-use-mcp/bridge.json` reports the live port, pid and start time. There is no separate log fil

e any more.
- Restart DSH after changing host/client code: plugin_manager enable/disable does not re

-read modules from disk (ESM cache).
- `BRIDGE_NOT_READY`: host half not started or stale bridge.jso

n; restart DSH.
- `CLIENT_OFFLINE`: the renderer in the current window is not polling (closed or swi

tching); keep the DSH window in front and retry.
- `NO_BROWSER_TAB`: no visible sidebar browser page

; open one in the right sidebar or call browser_open.
- `NO_SUCH_REF`: the ref is stale; call browse

right sidebar or call browser_open.
- `NO_SUCH_REF`: the ref is stale; call browser_snapshot again.
